_comment: DRISHTI QuickML no-code ML pipeline experiment (Phase 14 Part B / matrix row 12, workflow §8 baseline). This is the eligible no-code baseline used because Zia AutoML is unavailable in the India DC. It is an OFFLINE experiment over a versioned, aggregate, leakage-checked dataset - never triggered by a raw upload or a single FIR. Configured/run in Console -> QuickML; DISABLED here until an approved dataset release.
subject: aggregate area/period (NEVER a person / complainant / accused / FIR)

dataset.source: FeatureSnapshot aggregate export (area x period), versioned
dataset.feature_columns_note: leakage-safe aggregate features only; observation cutoff enforced

baseline_comparison: reported against the prior-period heuristic baseline before any promotion
outputs: metrics + cost/latency report -> human approval -> ModelVersion registration (no auto-promote)
